Refresh sources before selection. Verify selected versions at worker start.
Failed verification or changed versions stops the assessment.
Use one bounded agent. Keep 24 model calls and a 600-second deadline.
Store exact evidence versions. Save human review decisions separately.
No crawler. No independent reviewer role." tooltip="ASSESSMENT CONTROLS

All names identify planned roles. No deployed resource names exist.
TLS: Transport Layer Security. PKCE protects the sign-in code exchange.
IAM: AWS Identity and Access Management. API: application interface.
HTTPS/443 is intended transport. Live connections remain unverified.
Zones show responsibility and trust. They do not specify VPCs or subnets.
AWS SAM defines deployment. Local adapters use the same application logic." tooltip="DESIGN LIMITS

rect.title: DESIGN LIMITS All names identify planned roles. No deployed resource names exist. TLS: Transport Layer Security. PKCE protects the sign-in code exchange. IAM: AWS Identity and Access Management. API: application interface. HTTPS/443 is intended transport. Live connections remain unverified. Zones show responsibility and trust. They do not specify VPCs or subnets. AWS SAM defines deployment. Local adapters use the same application logic.
